title: Phantom Consensus: Measuring Social Reasoning in Multi-Agent LLM Decision-Making
title_zh: 幻象共识：测量多智能体LLM决策中的社会推理

paragraphs.en: 提出幻象共识现象与PHANTOM-Bench基准，揭示模糊社会信号可使多智能体LLM将正确私下判断变为错误公开共识。 Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly aggregate judgments across model instances, but reasoning about other agents can itself introduce failure. We study a setting in which LLMs shift their public decisions after observing ambiguous social signals while reporting inaccurate estimates of what other agents privately judged, even when the group's recorded private judgments do not support the apparent consensus. We call this failure phantom consensus and study it as a pluralistic-ignorance-style pattern in controlled LLM collectives. To measure this phenomenon, we introduce PHANTOM-Bench, a benchmark that separates isolated private judgments, public decisions after ambiguous social signals, elicited estimates of the group's private judgment, transparency-based recovery, and controls for neutral public text and explicit vote-following. Across nine closed- and open-weight models, ambiguous public signals consistently degrade decision quality and can turn correct private group judgments into incorrect public collective outcomes. Public accuracy drops by as much as 47.8 percentage points, and collective rationality failures reach 47.3% in the most susceptible setting. We observe substantial errors in reported group-private beliefs alongside public-stage failures, while control conditions reveal model-dependent differences in susceptibility to ambiguous and explicit peer signals. Revealing the agents' recorded private decisions repairs many failures without revealing the gold label, although recovery varies across models. Our results show that evaluating multi-agent LLM systems requires measuring not only final agreement, but whether that agreement reflects independently measured private judgments or an apparent consensus.
paragraphs.zh: 提出幻象共识现象与PHANTOM-Bench基准，揭示模糊社会信号可使多智能体LLM将正确私下判断变为错误公开共识。多智能体LLM系统日益跨模型实例聚合判断，但对其他智能体进行推理本身也可能引入失败。 我们研究这样一种情形：LLM在观察到模糊社会信号后会改变其公开决策，同时对其他智能体私下判断的报告估计不准确，即使该群体被记录的私下判断并不支持这一表面共识。 我们将这种失败称为幻象共识，并将其作为受控LLM集体中一种多元无知式的模式加以研究。 为测量这一现象，我们引入PHANTOM-Bench，该基准将孤立的私下判断、模糊社会信号后的公开决策、引导出的群体私下判断估计、基于透明度的恢复，以及针对中性公开文本和明确跟随投票的对照区分开来。 在九个闭源与开源权重模型上，模糊的公开信号一致地降低决策质量，并可将群体正确的私下判断转变为错误的公开集体结果。 公开准确率最多下降47.8个百分点，在最易受影响的设置下集体理性失败率达到47.3%。 我们观察到，在公开阶段失败的同时，所报告的群体私下信念也存在大量错误，而对照条件则揭示了各模型对模糊信号和明确同伴信号易感性上的差异。 在不揭示金标准标签的情况下，公开智能体被记录的私下决策即可修复许多失败，尽管恢复程度因模型而异。 我们的结果表明，评估多智能体LLM系统不仅需要测量最终一致性，还需要判断该一致性反映的是独立测得的私下判断还是一种表面共识。
